description.text: The professional was founded in 2003, from the art design (digital media art direction), after 2006 to the digital media art professional. Relying on the university level key discipline design, has a master's degree at the provincial teaching demonstration center of art and design, professional teachers, after 10 years of development, the formation of the training system to students entrepreneurial team led students to practice and industry closely with talent, with strong, broad employment "characteristics. Personnel training in the ecological design as a guide, focus on training students in the ecological and cultural derivatives network design, interaction design, visual effects and animation design and other aspects of the ability to create integrated digital media talents to the idea of ecological design. Graduates in research institutions, film and television animation, game industry, the Internet and other enterprises engaged in digital media art and design work.The professional training program, based on industry oriented, active docking Hangzhou cultural and creative industries, in accordance with national professional quality standards, pay attention to their aptitude and personality development, construction of the occupation skills as the core curriculum system; implement student-centered inquiry teaching mode, evaluation and academic innovation of classroom teaching, heuristic teaching case for the outstanding teaching reform oriented students' Autonomous learning.This is the professional digital media art and video art two professional direction module, training and skills with solid pictures, film and television, new media design, master image theory, journalism, advertising, art theory, has the ability to skillfully use all kinds of media professional creative design and application, in animation company, multimedia company, network company, Audiovisual Publishing departments, teaching and research departments, television, newspapers, higher education institutions, the advertising industry and the various state organs, enterprises and institutions, from senior applied talents working in the creation of new media.

duration.text: The Digital Media Art at Zhejiang Agriculture and Forestry University is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: For the students who have never studied in China：he Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcriptLanguage proficiency certificate Police Certificate within one year Other certificates or documents Foreigner physical examination form: bearing the stamp of the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 monthsApplication Form For School Family Information FormFinancial Income StatementA Short Video of Self IntroductionCommitment without Drug Use History Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）*For the transferred students who have already studied in China：The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) and Visa pageTranslated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcriptLast semester transcript in the previous schoolLanguage proficiency certificatePolice Certificate within one yearTransfer letter from last school include the attendance and performance certificate of verification from Entry-Exit inspection and Quarantine within 6 monthsApplication Form For SchoolFamily Information Form Financial Income StatementA Short Video of Self IntroductionCommitment without Drug Use History Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）

requirements.text: Applicants should be aged between 18 and 28 Applicant should be non-Chinese citizens with valid regular foreign passport and be friendly to China; *Residents of China who have emigrated to a foreign country and who are now applying to study in China as international students must have held a valid foreign passport for at least 4 years, and must have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years. (9 months of residence in a foreign country may count as a full year. The dates of the entry and exit stamps in the passport will be followed in the determination of the actual length of foreign residence).
